Need to consider cost, timeline, licensing, warranties, reputation (online vs word-of-mouth), risk assessment, mitigation (contract terms, references, payment schedule). Provide structured comparison, decision framework, questions to ask, red flags, suggestions for due diligence, maybe recommend a weighted scoring approach. Should be thorough, but concise. Also mention importance of detailed contract, insurance verification, checking BBB, references, etc. Provide final recommendation maybe leaning towards Premier but with conditions, or suggest getting third quotes. Provide actionable steps.

We must not disclose we are AI. Use supportive tone.

Also suggest due diligence like checking complaints, ask for references, see actual work. Provide advice on contract terms, holdback, etc. Provide possible compromise.
